frozen_source_review.scope: Reviewed complete frozen source for public API access, geometry provenance, bounded control and absence of seed branches or private evaluator access.
notes: No imports, filesystem, network, native simulator state, evaluator/reward/success access, seed lookup, or fixed object world poses.
Bottle and cabinet targets come from public point-cloud quantiles; remaining scalar distances, fractions, motion caps and tolerances are relative policy parameters.
The release path accepts terminal completion without masking a nonterminal command error.

final_coverage: 15 development and 15 exact-once unseen runs, 60 camera videos, selected source identity and capture settings audited PASS
